_comment: Phase MN.6 — SONG SECTION ROLES. What a Chorus does to a Verse, as data. The op NAMES are a fixed vocabulary implemented in Swift (LoopStarSectionOp); WHICH ops each role applies, and by how much, is content and ships by PR with no rebuild. A style may override any role in its material.json under `arranger.sectionOverrides`.
_source_of_truth: This file. The in-binary table in LoopStarSectionRecipe.swift is a clamped offline fallback only.

roles.label: Verse
roles.blurb: Pulls back so the next lift means something.

roles.label: Chorus
roles.blurb: The lift: simpler changes, bigger sound, the hook up an octave.

roles.label: Bridge
roles.blurb: Somewhere else for eight bars — new harmony, thinner band.

roles.label: Intro
roles.blurb: Sets the key and the pocket, holds most of the band back.

roles.label: Outro
roles.blurb: Winds down to the tonic and lets the air back in.

roles.label: Lift
roles.blurb: Everything up a gear — the last chorus, or the drop.
